DomainRating.description: A reviewer's quality [`Rating`] for one of a case's scoring domains.

rating.description: The reviewer's rating for this domain.

Rating.description:
A reviewer's subjective quality rating for a finished implementation.

Assigned by hand while playing the build, ordered best to worst. It is a per-run signal shown alongside a run, never an aggregate or a ranking across runs (see `docs/site.md`).

oneOf.description: Implemented according to spec with no noticeable bugs.
Implemented according to spec; may have minor issues that don't impact playability.
Mostly implemented according to spec. Playable, but deviates from the spec or has bugs that impact playability.
Doesn't follow the spec, or has bugs severe enough to render the game unplayable.

ReviewVerdict.description: A reviewer's recorded verdict on one declared checklist item.

note.description: An optional one-line note recording what the reviewer observed. `None` when the reviewer left no note.

status.description: The reviewer's verdict on the item.

VerdictStatus.description:
A reviewer's verdict on one declared checklist item.

A test case declares the checklist (see [`crate::test_case::ReviewItem`]); the reviewer records one of these per item while judging the build. Ordered by neither severity nor preference — it simply states what the reviewer found.

oneOf.description: The item was checked and the build satisfies it. The item earns its weight toward the run's score.
The item was checked and the build does not satisfy it. The item earns none of its weight.

description: One published review on a run: the reviewer's public identity, their per-domain ratings, the writeup, and their checklist verdicts. This is the canonical review wire shape (`backend-api/review.schema.json`), referenced by the per-run snapshot document.

ratings.description: The reviewer's rating for each scoring domain. This review's overall rating is the worst across them.

reviewedAt.description: RFC 3339 of when the review was submitted.

reviewer.description: The reviewer's display name, shown beside their review.

reviewerId.description: The reviewing account's id (stable across their reviews).

title: Review
